comments.author: mdrxy
comments.body:
Thanks for the repro. One question on usage context: is there a reason you are using the legacy `Fireworks` text-completion LLM class here instead of `ChatFireworks`?

For modern Fireworks chat/instruct models, `ChatFireworks` is generally the preferred integration, while `Fireworks` targets the older completions-style `/completions` endpoint and string-prompt `LLM` interface.

It would be helpful to understand whether this came from:

- direct application code using `Fireworks`
- older `LLMChain` / string-prompt code
- a completions-only Fireworks model
- migration from older LangChain APIs
- another library wrapping LangChain LLMs

If this is just chat/instruct usage, switching to `ChatFireworks` may be the better recommendation.
